description: A payout must not be released before its order line has been delivered and the required hold period has passed.
expected_detection: Flag a paid or released payout line whose delivery or reserve conditions are incomplete.

description: A commission must be deducted only once for an order line.
expected_detection: Compare the commission amount against the applicable seller commission rule.

description: A suspended seller must not continue selling through an active listing.
expected_detection: Flag active listings belonging to suspended sellers.

description: A lost or refunded dispute must be reflected in the seller payout calculation.
expected_detection: Compare dispute outcomes with payout deductions.

description: The payout total must equal the sum of its payout line net amounts.
expected_detection: Recalculate payout totals from their payout lines.
